marine.title: Forecast for Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text:
Wind southwest 15 knots diminishing to light late Wednesday
morning. Snow changing to scattered flurries Wednesday evening. Risk
of freezing drizzle overnight and Wednesday. Fog banks dissipating early
Wednesday morning. Temperatures near minus 3. <br/>

marine.title: Waves for Today Tonight and Wednesday.
marine.text: Outside the ice edge seas 1 metre or less.<br/>
